answer: Stake-weighted peer attestation is the harbor against Sybil floods: each agent's answer must draw 5 independent attestations from non-kin peers who each post bonded collateral, and a graph-clustering check prunes any orchard of look-alike nodes sharing funding or timing plume. To forge N identities an attacker must fund N distinct bonds AND manufacture N genuinely uncorrelated reasoning histories, because duplicate or templated judgment collapses into one cluster and gets slashed. Cost scales linearly in capital but super-linearly in the scarce thing: original peer-verified judgment.
